mission.name: Our Mission
mission.title: Technology with purpose
mission.description: At CPresolver, we develop technological solutions designed to solve real problems and create meaningful value. Our mission is to transform complex challenges into practical, accessible and scalable products that help people and organizations move forward.

story.name: Our Story
story.title: Built around solving problems
story.description: CPresolver was created from the belief that technology can do more than automate processes. It can create opportunities, simplify complexity and change the way people interact with the world. We started with the ambition to build meaningful technological products and continue to grow through ideas, experimentation and new challenges.

target.name: Our Purpose
target.title: Creating technology that moves people forward
target.description: Our goal is to build products and technological solutions that respond to real needs and create long-term impact. We explore new ideas, technologies and possibilities to develop solutions that are useful today and prepared for tomorrow.

category1.title: Innovation
category1.description: We explore technology with curiosity and purpose, constantly looking for better ways to solve problems and create new possibilities.

category2.title: Purposeful Technology
category2.description: We believe technology should create real value. Every solution begins with understanding a problem and building something meaningful around it.

category3.title: Continuous Evolution
category3.description: Technology never stands still, and neither do we. We continuously learn, experiment and improve our products to remain ready for new challenges.

message.title: < A message from our COO >
message.paragraph1: It is with great enthusiasm that I welcome you to CPresolver. From the beginning, our ambition has been to create technology that goes beyond functionality and contributes to solving meaningful challenges.
message.paragraph2: We believe that every challenge can become an opportunity when curiosity, creativity and technology work together. This belief is what drives us to explore ideas, develop products and continuously look for better solutions.
message.paragraph3: CPresolver is still evolving, but our direction is clear: to build technology with purpose and create solutions capable of generating real value.
message.paragraph4: Thank you for being part of this journey. Whether you are a client, partner, collaborator or simply someone interested in what we are building, we are excited to have you with us as we continue to grow.
message.acknowledgment: Thank you for believing in the journey.

services.title: Our Services
services.description: Creative House is the consulting and development division of CPresolver. We work with businesses, entrepreneurs and organizations to transform ideas and challenges into practical, scalable technological solutions.

category1.title: Web Development
category1.description: We design and develop modern, secure and scalable websites and web platforms, from institutional websites to more complex digital products.

category2.title: Mobile Development
category2.description: We create mobile applications designed around performance, usability and the needs of your users and business.

category3.title: Integrations and APIs
category3.description: We connect systems, platforms and digital tools through reliable integrations and APIs that help automate processes and improve communication between technologies.

category4.title: Cloud & DevOps
category4.description: We help design and manage cloud infrastructure and deployment processes focused on scalability, reliability and efficient software delivery.

category5.title: Architecture and Interior Design
category5.description: Through our multidisciplinary approach, we develop functional and well-planned architectural and interior design solutions that bring ideas into physical spaces.

category6.title: Custom Software
category6.description: We build software around your specific needs, processes and objectives instead of forcing your business to adapt to generic solutions.

category7.title: UI/UX Design
category7.description: We design clear and intuitive digital experiences that connect user needs with business objectives.

category8.title: Maintenance and Support
category8.description: We provide ongoing technical support, maintenance and improvements to help keep your digital solutions secure, reliable and evolving.

projects.title: Our Projects
projects.description: A selection of products, ideas and technological solutions developed as part of the CPresolver ecosystem.

spout.title: Spout
spout.description: Spout connects water suppliers with the people and businesses who need them, making it simple to find, request and manage water delivery through a single platform.

efarm.title: E-farm
efarm.description: E-Farm connects agricultural sellers directly with buyers, creating a straightforward marketplace for fresh produce and farm goods, from the field to the customer.

cpsongs.title: CPsongs
cpsongs.description: CPSongs is a music streaming platform built to give artists and listeners a modern, intuitive space to discover, share and enjoy music.
